title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of type 2 diabetes and peripheral neuropathy.

History of Present Illness
The patient is a known patient with a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus and peripheral neuropathy. He reports feeling stable since his last visit. He confirms taking his prescribed oral hypoglycemic agent, metformin, as directed. He denies any new numbness or tingling since his last appointment.

Medication List
Metformin daily.

Exam
Vitals: Stable. Neuro: Decreased sensation noted bilaterally in the stocking distribution, consistent with peripheral neuropathy. Skin exam revealed no acute findings.

Assessment
1. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Stable on current regimen.
2. Peripheral Neuropathy: Stable.

Plan
Continue metformin daily. Patient advised to monitor foot care and report any changes in sensation or wounds. Follow up in three months.
explanations: Polyneuropathy is listed under 'with' for diabetes: the combination code E11.42 captures both.
Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

distractors.why: Coding the two separately misses the presumed link.
Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.
